#### Veeam

**Restore**

This dashboard gives visibility into restore sessions in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total and failed restore events, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces restore objects and virtual machines. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a restore-operations view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
